text:
ashley (partnerships): Quick kickoff — cloud marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Primary outcomes: tenant mapping approach, trial SKU behavior, private-offer flow, and KMS/Auth checklist. Can we collect owners and blockers?
kevin (cloud-platform): Regions we should stage first: us-west-2, europe-west1, asia-southeast1? Also need to know if we support private offers per-region or global.
jamal (product): Packaging decision needed: single bundle with feature flags vs separate SKUs for Dedicated/Dedicated-Private. I'm leaning single bundle + flags to reduce listing churn. Thoughts?
maria (legal): Need final EULA & data residency clauses for EU/AU. Also want explicit language on telemetry and marketplace metering data — who owns aggregated usage data. Can someone drop a sample telemetry flow?
lucy (eng): For IAM/KMS: prefer cross-account AWS role + external ID for marketplace provisioning; GCP = service account with limited IAM bindings. Quick terraform snippet for the AWS role we use in staging:
```terraform
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_integ" {
  name = "redwood-marketplace-staging-role"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [{
      Action = "sts:AssumeRole",
      Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::MARKETPLACE_ACCOUNT:root" },
      Effect = "Allow",
      Condition = { StringEquals = { "sts:ExternalId" = var.external_id } }
    }]
  })
}
```
lucy (eng): I'll open a PR with that plus KMS key policy suggestions.
kevin (cloud-platform): Metering note: marketplace requires unique offer IDs per listing/region. Suggest pattern: <offer-prefix>-r{region}-{tier} so ops can route billing. Also watch quota limits on customer trial activations (rate limit testing needed).
ashley (partnerships): Can someone own the day-0 staging runbook and creds rotation? I'll coordinate cross-team. @maria can you sign off on trial entitle wording by EOD Friday?
maria (legal): :thumbsup: I'll review. Need to see sample telemetry and the wording around retention. If we collect logs for quality monitoring, we need opt-in language for EU customers.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: marketplace-staging sandbox account created — temp creds posted to #secret-ops, auto-rotate in 24h.
jamal (product): I'll update the packaging checklist and add a note that trial SKUs should map to entitlement codes in the marketplace payload. Also will include a link to the telemetry schema once lucy posts it.
ashley (partnerships): Action items: lucy -> IAM/KMS PR + docs; kevin -> region/offer-id scheme + quota test plan; jamal -> packaging checklist + docs; maria -> EULA/trial wording signoff. Weekly sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to close blockers. :calendar:
